items.title: Wolves STUNNED! Andri Gudjohnsen silences Molineux as Rovers take lead!
items.description: Andri Gudjohnsen silences Molineux as Blackburn Rovers take the lead over Wolves.

items.title: Super Giants storm into Hundred men's final with win over SunRisers
items.description: The Manchester Super Giants set up a meeting with Trent Rockets in The Hundred final after beating SunRisers Leeds by 20 runs in the men's eliminator at The Kia Oval.

items.title: 'Rovers STUN Molineux!' | McLoughlin's first English football goal levels it up
items.description: Sean McLoughlin's first goal in English football levels the game for Blackburn as they face Wolves at Molineux.

items.title: All done deals in August 2026
items.description: Check out the significant signings and departures in the Premier League, Scottish Premiership, EFL and Women's Super League.

items.title: Burnley sign Chelsea's Satpayev on loan
items.description: Chelsea's new teenage winger Dastan Satpayev joins Championship club Burnley on a season's loan.

items.title: Departing Romero says he wasn't perfect at Spurs
items.description: Cristian Romero says he "wasn't perfect" during his five-year stint at Tottenham Hotspur as he prepares to complete a move to Atletico Madrid.

items.title: Romero announces Spurs exit ahead of Atletico transfer
items.description: Tottenham captain Cristian Romero has confirmed he is leaving the club ahead of his move to Atletico Madrid being announced.

items.title: Stokes' Durham progress with Flintoff unable to repeat hundred heroics
items.description: A Durham side featuring Ben Stokes thrashed Lancashire by 162 runs to reach the One Day Cup semi-finals with Rocky Flintoff unable to repeat his hundred heroics from earlier in the week.

items.title: Liverpool takeover Q&A: What do we know about Bezos' consortium?
items.description: Liverpool's owners Fenway Sports Group have sold a stake in Liverpool Football Club to a consortium including Amazon founder Jeff Bezos.

items.title: Gay bags pair in Test warm-up as Pakistan captain Babar suffers injury scare
items.description: England opener Emilio Gay bagged a pair and Pakistan captain Babar Azam suffered an injury scare on an eventful second day of the Test match-warm up in Beckenham.

items.title: Teenage British cyclist Tarling dies after accident during Volta a Portugal
items.description: British cyclist Finlay Tarling, 19, has died after a serious accident during the eighth stage of the Volta a Portugal road race.

items.title: Man City miss Chelsea's deadline to bid for Fernandez
items.description: The 5pm Friday deadline set by Chelsea for Man City to make their bid for Enzo Fernandez has passed with no offer made for the midfielder.
